What CityScroll cannot verify

CityScroll's sources do not carry these -- this is not a finding that they are missing from the actual solicitation package.

  • Full package eligibility requirements
  • Experience requirements
  • Staffing or team requirements
  • Q&A content
  • Amendment documents
  • Internal issuing team
  • An existing relationship with the agency
  • Whether your team can staff this in time
